item.title: SES deepens Elveo Mobile bet as direct-to-device race narrows to three
item.summary: SES has expanded its strategic investment in Elveo Mobile, the direct-to-device operator formed this week from the completed merger of Lynk Global and Omnispace, giving the satellite race for standard smartphones a clearer three-way shape. The post SES deepens Elveo Mobile bet as direct-to-device race narrows to three appeared first on Capacity .
